about_attempt: the FOURTH BLEND attempt, the first flight after the ranker scale defect was repaired

attempt4_ceiling.basis: Pass A is REPLAYED from attempt 3's hash-pinned landed texts at ZERO core contacts, so the only contacts attempt 4 can spend are the canary, one Pass-B evidence contact per DISPATCHING trajectory, and the identical-prompt resend
attempt4_ceiling.why_zero_tool_contacts: every Pass-A text is already covered by attempt 3's durable query-vector table, so the offline bridge has nothing to embed and the sidecar never needs to be spawned

inputs.policy: the FROZEN v1 cell (alpha 0.45, tau 0.65, top-k 5, m 5 / c 2 / top_l 3, rrf 0.5/0.3/0.2) through rails.kb_policy's OWN pure functions, with the 1341c2db repair live
inputs.query_texts: attempt 3's LANDED Pass-A direct-decode texts -- the exact texts attempt 4 REPLAYS rather than re-flies, so the dispatch set here is the set the flight takes, not an estimate of it

margin_rationale: The dispatch set is EXACT under a deterministic policy over fixed texts and fixed vectors, so the margin is not there for the policy. It covers only serving-side residuals: an evidence contact that has to be re-sent, or a trajectory whose evidence decode fails once and is retried. It is deliberately small because the cell binds.
